name: RadarChart.data
description: Data array - each item represents a data series (polygon)

name: RadarChart.metrics
description: Metrics to display on the radar

name: RadarChart.size
description: Chart size in pixels. If not provided, uses parent container size

name: RadarChart.levels
description: Number of concentric grid circles. Default: 5

name: RadarChart.margin
description: Margin around the chart. Default: 60

name: RadarChart.animate
description: Enable animations. Default: true

name: RadarChart.enterDurationMs
description: Enter animation budget in ms. Default: 1100

name: RadarChart.staggerScale
description: Scales stagger timing (1 = default).

name: RadarChart.enterTransition
description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

name: RadarChart.motionReplayKey
description: Changes when motion settings change — replays enter animations.

name: RadarChart.hoveredIndex
description: Controlled hover state - index of hovered area

name: RadarChart.onHoverChange
description: Callback when hover state changes

name: RadarChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: RadarChart.children
description: Child components (RadarGrid, RadarAxis, RadarLabels, RadarArea)

name: RadarGrid.showLabels
description: Show level value labels. Default: true

name: RadarGrid.stroke
description: Grid line stroke color. Default: var(--border)

name: RadarGrid.strokeOpacity
description: Grid line stroke opacity. Default: 0.6

name: RadarGrid.className
description: Additional class name

name: RadarAxis.stroke
description: Axis line stroke color. Default: var(--border)

name: RadarAxis.strokeOpacity
description: Axis line stroke opacity. Default: 0.6

name: RadarAxis.className
description: Additional class name

name: RadarLabels.offset
description: Distance from the chart edge. Default: 24

name: RadarLabels.fontSize
description: Font size for labels. Default: 11

name: RadarLabels.interactive
description: Enable interactive hover on labels. Default: false

name: RadarLabels.className
description: Additional class name

name: RadarArea.index
description: Index of this area in the data array

name: RadarArea.color
description: Optional color override

name: RadarArea.fillOpacity
description: Fill opacity when idle. Default: 0.15

name: RadarArea.strokeDasharray
description: SVG outline dash pattern, e.g. "4 4" for a previous period.

name: RadarArea.onPointHover
description: Observe metric-point hover to compose a tooltip through TooltipBox.

name: RadarArea.showPoints
description: Show data point circles. Default: true

name: RadarArea.showStroke
description: Show stroke outline on the polygon. Default: true

name: RadarArea.showGlow
description: Show glow effect on hover. Default: true

name: RadarArea.className
description: Additional class name
